notes: Class profile is labeled This Year 2025 (entering fall 2025); the program's own class profile page titles it Rice Business Full-Time MBA Class of 2027 Profile. GMAT edition is not labeled on the page; recorded as classic because a 693 average is implausible on the Focus scale (would be roughly 99th percentile) and is continuous with Rice's classic-era 3-year average of 702 shown on the same page; no Focus-labeled figure is published. Acceptance rate not published on official pages. Employment statistics PDF is hosted on cdn.uconnectlabs.com, linked from the official Rice CDO reports page (cdo.business.rice.edu/outcomes/). The school's career highlights page for the same class states 146K average starting salary and 32K average signing bonus. Rice publishes average GMAT 693 (mid-50% 675-720) with no edition label on the class profiles page; not recorded per the edition-ambiguity rule.
